suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add to Key Technical Details: 'Extended PS/2 keys (arrow, navigation, right modifiers, NumpadEnter, NumpadDivide) use QEMU key numbers with 0x80 bit OR'd onto the base scancode. Standard keys use raw PS/2 Set 1 scancodes unchanged. See .factory/library/architecture.md for the full mapping.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature fix-extended-scancodes revealed that the original SCANCODE_MAP used raw PS/2 codes for extended keys, causing arrow keys to map to numpad keys. The dual encoding convention (raw PS/2 for standard keys, base|0x80 for extended) is documented in library/architecture.md but not mentioned in AGENTS.md where workers first learn about keyboard input.
